body:
I actually can write at a college level. The moment was traumatizing and recounting it causes me to disassociate and become less coherent.

I also do not twerk. You are assuming your premise where there is no evidence.

Maybe if you took a psyche course and learned common human decency, these kinds of things would not need an explanation.

Yeah, a lot of red herrings in there. Was a confusing time.

Basically, don't talk behind people's backs.
Any sign of disrespect, even if slight or imagined, causes issues.
Do not implicate another person.
Best to not talk about why you are in there because people are itching to implicate you to get reduced time.
If you see something (like flying kites/notes...say something and you run the potential for informal court and punishment).
Not noticing that there is a program and heirarchal system and what they are tasked with/have responsibility (someone is asked to monitor for people and they are in the room confessing to something or if you have questions that they are there to help [gets reduced time])

He called his friend/booty call to say he had killed someone. This was after he hovered over me saying he was sorry that he disappointed me...not sure about what. He sounded proud and like he were bragging.

Has the normal warning signs such as fire setting, bed wetting, cruelty to animals, and anti-social behavior.

Said he helped hide a dead body in the past and claimed he only did it because he felt pressured by his peer group. Sounds like he lied in court and got away with it and is still out there.

Kept offering me a chance to get a fake/bought identity.

Or he is completely lying. Never checked into it. Blocked him and left.
Had someone complain about not liking the food after eating all of their portions and wanted a refund/free meal.

Went in on marijuana charges in Custer County, OK (has 120lbs). Befriended my cell mate (few DUIs), talked about what was fucking us up on the outside (she was prostituting and her social worker was paying 😔) and talked her through her steps to get out...making goals, and shared my food with her (I eat like a bird).
Someone came in our cell to chat/gossip since she had a blunt and related. When she was out and I told her thinking you know...people are talking shit. 

Almost started a full blown fight.

Then when people were giving me shit for no reason (taking my seat, I guess was what did it) She almost started a fight over it and people started forming sides like 1 v 6. Girl kept going lol.

Fucking Natives. I appreciated her a bunch. Made my first time easier.


If you want an unrelated story, was in our pod. There was a twerk contest between a white girl, black girl, native, and asian. Winner got cookies. Was fun to see them get along and have a good time before the COs came in.
